phase: Reference Mode Recovery — Government Effective Interest Rate
scientific_interpretation: The reference target is the Ministry of Finance published year-end average interest rate of the government public-debt portfolio.

The source definition is a portfolio cost measure based on forecast interest payments for the following year relative to the debt stock existing at the reference year end, calculated across debt instruments.
It is therefore retained as an annual year-end target and is not interpolated to quarters.
It is not the Eurostat Maastricht apparent cost, not a same-year realized cash-interest rate, and not a marginal sovereign or new-issuance yield.
Observed portfolio-cost targets do not identify the repricing share m[t], matched old/new rates, or a refinancing link; the government refinancing/effective-rate mechanism remains DEFERRED.
